players.product: DataSafe TPPL (thin plate pure lead) UPS batteries and DataSafe Noir lithium battery systems for data centers, with installation and service

quarterly_data.signal: 8-K (July 23, 2026): after a strategic review EnerSys revised the scope of its planned lithium-ion cell plant in Greenville, South Carolina to an initial capacity of up to 1 gigawatt-hour, compared with approximately 4 to 5 gigawatt-hours as originally planned, with a materially smaller footprint, refocused on aerospace and defense and specialized industrial applications (foreign entity of concern (FEOC) compliant cells). Besides the DOE grant, South Carolina and Greenville County awarded an incentive package valued at approximately $200 million. EnerSys intends to transition away from its technology relationship with Verkor and expects to leverage an established technology partnership within its existing aerospace and defense supply base. CEO Shawn O'Connell: the approach supports customers where domestic production is essential 'while generating incremental revenue opportunities beyond our internal supply needs'.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 1 gigawatt-hour initial capacity vs approximately 4 to 5 gigawatt-hours originally planned; ~$200 million state and local incentives
